To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Connecticut Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Copies of all legal services invoices and related billing records paid, received, or incurred by Thomaston Public Schools from July 1, 2025, through November 19, 2026.

This request includes all legal services provided to or on behalf of Thomaston Public Schools, the Thomaston Board of Education, the superintendent's office, district administration, individual schools, and any other department, office, employee, or representative acting in an official capacity.

This request is intended to encompass all legal services, regardless of their nature, purpose, subject matter, funding source, or the attorney or law firm providing the services. This includes, but is not limited to, general counsel, personnel and employment matters, labor relations, collective bargaining, grievances, litigation, investigations, contracts, special education, regulatory compliance, governance, and any other legal matters. These examples are illustrative and do not limit the scope of this request.

I specifically request complete, itemized invoices and billing statements, including, to the extent maintained, dates of service, descriptions of services performed, attorney or staff names, hours billed, hourly rates, expenses, and amounts charged. This request includes invoices that remain unpaid, as well as those already paid, and invoices paid through insurance, other governmental entities, or alternative funding arrangements, to the extent such records are maintained by the district.

I recognize that certain information may be protected by attorney-client privilege or another applicable exemption under Connecticut law. I am not requesting disclosure of privileged communications or legally exempt information. Where specific portions of an invoice are exempt, I request that only those portions be redacted and that all remaining nonexempt information be provided. Please do not withhold entire invoices solely because they contain some exempt information.

I also request that, if possible and pursuant to Conn. Gen. Stat. § 1-212(d), fees be waived as I believe this request is in the public interest and not made for commercial gain. The requested documents will be made available to the public at MuckRock.com.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 4 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Sam Bellford

title: CAD Call Logs & Arrest Information - Disneyland Resort (Oct 1, 2026)

communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: CAD Call Logs & Arrest Information - Disneyland Resort (Oct 1, 2026)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Public Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD) incident logs, Calls for Service entries, and any associated public arrest log information maintained by the Anaheim Police Department for incidents occurring on October 1, 2026, between 12:00 PM and 10:00 PM at the Disneyland Resort (including 1313 S. Harbor Blvd, 1580 S. Disneyland Dr, and surrounding resort property). Specifically, I am seeking records related to an incident involving an intoxicated adult female that may have resulted in a public intoxication arrest (PC § 647(f)), a disturbance warning, or a medical/protective transport to a nearby hospital. Pursuant to California Government Code §§ 7923.610 and 7923.615, please provide:

1. All CAD / Call for Service log entries matching this timeframe and location involving an intoxicated person, disturbance, medical aid, or welfare check, including the time of the call, nature/substance of the complaint, officer response times, and final disposition;
2. If an arrest occurred, the disclosable arrest information mandated under Government Code § 7923.610 (name, physical description, time/date of booking, factual circumstances, and charges).

Please note I am requesting statutory public CAD logs and arrest summaries, not exempt investigative reports or protected medical/mental health records. If individual names must be redacted due to non-arrest or medical privacy exemptions, please provide the redacted CAD log showing the call details and disposition.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Chris Hoven

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Any and all records in the possession of the Dawson County Sheriff's Office relating to the arrest of Marcus Satterfield on or about June 8, 2022, on charges including sexual battery, rape, and child molestation.

This request includes, but is not limited to:

1. Initial incident reports and arrest reports, including supplemental and narrative reports
2. Booking records, arrest warrants, and warrant applications
3. Investigative reports, case files, and investigator notes
4. Reports, summaries, or transcripts of interviews with witnesses, complainants, or the arrestee
5. Audio and video recordings of any interviews or interrogations, including forensic interviews
6. Body worn camera footage, dash camera footage, and any other audio or video recorded in connection with the investigation or arrest
7. 911 calls, dispatch audio, and CAD (computer aided dispatch) logs
8. Photographs and evidence or property logs
9. Emails, memos, or other correspondence about the investigation or arrest

I understand that information identifying any minor or alleged victim may be redacted as required by law. I ask that any such redactions be made so the remainder of each record can be released, rather than withholding records in full.

If any record or portion of a record is withheld, please identify the specific statutory exemption relied on for each, as required by O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71. If you contend that the pending investigation or prosecution exemption in O.C.G.A. § 50-18-72(a)(4) applies, please confirm whether the case is still pending and release the initial arrest and incident reports, which that exemption does not cover.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Silence Dogood
